name: Hiiragi Karin
source:
"The Puppy-like Chick & Easygoing Hacker"
Hobbies: Net games

Kyoichiro's, the protagonist's, childhood friend and fellow schoolmate. She serves as the Spy Club's hacker and is a my-pace character. Karin has her own, unique view of world and sees everything through her "Potentionmeter", through which she can see does somebody have enough "potential", and she often discusses this subject with her friends.

"I can definitely smell the potential around here..."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=689783]The Getchu site[/url]]
